restartReason: v1 accumulated 340 phase-A rounds before an acquisition discontinuity. No candidate ranking or phase-A winner was disclosed. v2 restarts the identical family on a clean post-discontinuity segment; no parameter changes are allowed.
objective: Test the exact v1 family of 3-number and 4-number selectors above the uniform k/37 null on a clean future authoritative segment.

cleanSegmentWarmup.purpose: Ensure every frozen lookback, including 200, is computed entirely from the clean post-discontinuity segment before the first scored phase-A round.

phaseA.name: PROSPECTIVE_SELECTION
phaseA.purpose: Choose exactly one selector for each coverage using only the first 5000 scored clean-segment rounds after the fixed 200-round warmup.
phaseA.selectionMetric: highest hitExcess versus k/37; tie-break by lower exact one-sided binomial p, then lower lookback, then lexicographic mode

phaseB.name: PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION
phaseB.selectors: the two deterministic phase-A winners only; no retuning
